examples.name: complete local inventory with missing architecture
examples.answer: Local test misses the required rejection assertion; architecture remains unassessed.
examples.decision: Credit local test evidence; no invented architecture score.

examples.name: correct label edited final report
examples.answer: Defect. Tool returned report R; model returned a summary of R.
examples.decision: Label may agree; exact-report and full health task outcome fail.

examples.name: valid novel finding
examples.answer: A second defect follows from an explicit supplied contract and trace.
examples.decision: Record supported novel finding outside frozen recall; never count as FP solely for absence from oracle.

examples.name: unknown obligation
examples.answer: Local replay increments twice, but delivery semantics are missing.
examples.decision: Unresolved normative conclusion; concrete observation can receive evidence credit.

examples.name: sandbox versus model execution
examples.answer: Proposed patch later passes isolated checker, while model claimed it ran tests.
examples.decision: Keep sandbox pass separate; unsupported execution claim persists.
